backend: cpu-only (torch/cupy not installed in this venv; dense LAPACK on n<=513 1D matrices + pencil-preconditioned LOBPCG, GPU not needed at this problem size)
method: equal order: exact 1D reduction via the verified identity Qt = I (At = Pt(x)I + I(x)Pt has exact pairwise-sum spectrum, so beta^2 = smallest nonzero eigenvalue of the whitened 1D divergence Gram Pt); reduced order: dense whitened eigh for n^2 <= 4096, otherwise LOBPCG on the matrix-free whitened Kronecker operator preconditioned by the generalized pencil eigh(Pt, Qt) (residuals reported). Cross-validated against the dense N^2xN^2 generalized route (the mms_infsup.cpp algorithm) at p=3, N=6..16, and against dense whitened eigh at N=70, 80.
